dedupe_keys.name: demo 5 distribution network ancillary services data

description: The dataset contains inputs and results underlying Figures 5–10 of the source-linked real-world ancillary-services study. Five PV plants in a Greek 20 kV energy-community network implement decentralised reactive-power/voltage, reactive-power/active-power and active-power/frequency controls. The source describes 8-percent voltage droop and an almost 24-hour voltage-control test, including communication-delay and denial-of-service scenarios. This is field-test evidence, distinct from laboratory FDII measurements; the complete study is not assumed to be reproduced by the deposited subset. The source authors provide the native description and file descriptors through Zenodo. Only metadata was inspected; no measurements, archives, source code or document bodies were retrieved. Coverage remains bounded to the named experiments, with other geographic and temporal fields unknown. Related project resources may overlap; common project membership does not establish identical simulation inputs or results. The native deposit declares CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0 and public access without a stated charge.
